short_summary: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. Under the scheme an income support of ₹6,000/- per year in three equal installments is provided to all landholding farmer families, subject to certain exclusion criteria relating to higher income status.
benefits_summary: ₹6,000 per year directly credited to the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account in 3 installments of ₹2,000 every four months.
application_process: Farmers can self-register through the Farmers Corner on pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with land revenue records and Aadhaar.
source_authority: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

detailed_description: Introduced by the Department of Higher & Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra, this scheme provides financial assistance to students admitted to government, government-aided, and non-aided private professional institutions whose annual family income is up to ₹8,00,000.
benefits_summary: 50% reimbursement of tuition fees and exam fees for eligible professional and non-professional higher education courses.

College Admission Bonafide Certificate / Fee Receipt
application_process: Apply online through the MahaDBT portal under the Directorate of Higher Education (DHE) or Technical Education (DTE). Submit verified documents to college nodal officer.

application_process: Register on the MahaDBT portal, select VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, fill academic information and upload verified caste and income certificates.

official_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
short_summary: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across India.
detailed_description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-financed health assurance scheme. It provides cashless access to healthcare services for the beneficiary at the point of service in empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
benefits_summary: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year covering medical examination, treatment, consultation, pre- and post-hospitalization, and diagnostic services.
application_process: Check eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit an Ayushman Mitra at any empaneled hospital / CSC with Aadhaar and Ration Card to create an Ayushman Card.
source_authority: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, GoI

detailed_description: Instituted by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, this scheme supports meritorious students from economically weaker sections. 50% of scholarships are earmarked for female students.

application_process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP scholarships.gov.in). Verification performed by institution and State Nodal Officer.

short_summary: Financial grant of ₹1.20 Lakhs to ₹1.30 Lakhs for constructing a pucca house with basic amenities for homeless rural households.
detailed_description: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with water, sanitation, and electricity to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits_summary: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 (plains) or ₹1,30,000 (hilly/difficult areas) in instalments linked to construction milestones, plus 90 days of MGNREGS wages.
application_process: Beneficiary identification based on SECC 2011 and Awaas+ list verified by Gram Sabha. Registration facilitated through the Gram Panchayat or AwaasApp.

short_summary: Monthly social security pension for destitute senior citizens aged 60 and above living below poverty line.
detailed_description: Part of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP), IGNOAPS provides non-contributory pensions to elderly citizens belonging to households below the poverty line.

required_documents: BPL Ration Card or Income Certificate (<= ₹1 Lakh)
application_process: Submit application to the Tahsildar / Block Development Officer (BDO) or apply through the State Portal / services.india.gov.in.
source_authority: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
